newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: TENNIS-CORRETJA BEATS CLAVET TO WIN ESTORIL OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CORRETJA BEATS CLAVET TO WIN ESTORIL OPEN.

text.p: Spain's Alex Corretja beat compatriot Francisco Clavet 6-3 7-5 on Sunday to win the Estoril Open and collect his first ATP title in three years.

After winning the first set, the 23-year-old Catalan appeared to have let Clavet back into the match and had to come back from 5-2 down in the second set to clinch his first tournament since winning in Buenos Aires in 1994.

"It was a very important win for me. It had been nearly three years (since winning a tournament) and I was beginning to think it would never happen," said Corretja, who picked up a winning cheque for $82,000.
Corretja, ranked 21st in the world before the tournament, said his ambition was now to reach the top 10.
But it was Clavet, who eliminated Spanish number one Carlos Moya in the quarter-finals, who began the stronger of the two.
He broke Corretja to take a 3-1 lead but did not win another game in the first set as Corretja lifted his game a gear.
The second set followed a similar pattern, the left-handed Clavet moving on to the attack and Corretja seeming to lose confidence as the Lisbon heat began to take its toll.
But just as Clavet seemed set to take the match into a third set, Corretja broke him to love for 5-4 and an ace and a service winner then let Corretja tie the scores at 5-5.
He broke Clavet again and served out the match to take the championship, the first clay court tournament of the European season, in one hour and 45 minutes.
